modifications.name: Disjunctor

5.summary: +10% charge speed after a headshot with a fully charged weapon, lasting 10 seconds and stacking up to 5 times. +50% damage with Bolt shots.

acquisition.text: After Clampdown, Miguel texts that King left a package at V’s Megabuilding H10 apartment. The package contains Disjunctor. This route is community-documented, not independently game-tested.

sources.name: Nukes & Dragons — tiers and individual compatibility
Gamestegy — effect, acquisition and individual fits

verificationNotes: Listed as a new iconic Tech mod in patch 2.5 by Gamestegy and cross-listed by Nukes & Dragons. The official notes confirm Clampdown but do not name this reward.
Community source values and installation behavior have not been independently game-tested. This is not a Chimera-core mod; do not apply Chimera removability to it.
Nukes & Dragons lists 12 fits; Gamestegy lists 13 including HA-4 Grit (Barghest). Only their common individual fits are used here; the variant remains unverified.
